scripts.assets: python3 scripts/prepare.py && node scripts/fetch-moo.mjs && python3 scripts/audio.py
scripts.render: npm run render:open-order && npm run render:execution
scripts.frames: npm run frames:open-order && npm run frames:execution
scripts.verify:render: node scripts/verify-render.mjs output/beta-launch-open-order.mp4 && node scripts/verify-render.mjs output/beta-launch-execution.mp4
scripts.render:open-order: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts BetaLaunchOpenOrder output/beta-launch-open-order.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k --concurrency=4
scripts.render:execution: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts BetaLaunchExecution output/beta-launch-execution.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k --concurrency=4
